The player uses various cannons and maneuvers to target and destroy enemy ships, with visual indicators showing progress towards the objective. The player engages in a naval battle against the HMS Ipswich as part of the mission 'A World Without Gold'. The player maneuvers their ship amidst stormy conditions, targeting enemy vessels and engaging in combat using various weapons and tactics. The player uses various tactics, including targeting barrels and using the ship's cannons to weaken the enemy. The player engages in a naval battle against the HMS Ipswich under stormy conditions. The objective is to disable the ship using various tactics, including boarding and strategic maneuvers. The player engages in a naval battle against the HMS Ipswich, using various ship maneuvers and weaponry to disable the enemy vessel amidst stormy conditions.
